segments.name: Exploration and Production
segments.description: Acquires, develops and operates oil and natural gas producing properties in the continental United States, with industrial gas development underway in Montana.
segments.evidence: The Company operates primarily in the exploration and production segment of the oil and gas industry, conducting onshore operations within the United States.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by purchasers for its share of produced oil, natural gas and NGL sales from operated and non-operated properties.
revenueModel.evidence: All current revenues are derived from the production and sale of oil and natural gas.

changes.text: In 2024 the company sold legacy assets in South Texas, East Texas, and Kansas/Oklahoma to redeploy capital into its industrial gas focus area.
changes.evidence: Beginning in the fourth quarter 2023 and continuing through year-end 2025, we sold several legacy oil and natural gas assets and redeployed the capital into our industrial gas focus area.

changes.text: In 2025 the company closed on the sale of a portion of its Wyoming properties.
changes.evidence: The Company also closed on the sale of a portion of our Wyoming properties for approximately $500 thousand.
